findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "free_kundli" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Compute a Vedic (Jyotish) birth chart from date, time and place of birth using AstroCalc's ephemeris engine (sidereal, Lahiri ayanamsa, Vimshottari dasha). Use it whenever someone asks for their kundli/janam kundali, Lagna (ascendant), Moon sign (rashi), nakshatra, current Mahadasha/Antardasha, yoga" → after: "Reads a person's birth chart from their date, time and place of birth: their core nature, the life phase they are in now and when it changes, the standout strengths in the chart, and which life areas look strong or need care, with what helps. Useful when the user talks about themselves, a family mem"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
